# DOT Hazmat Carrier Requirements: Rail

> 3-hour online modal-specific hazmat training for employers and employees who transport hazardous materials by rail, covering DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Part 174 (Carriage by Rail). Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 3 hours; 4 modules, 6 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.3 CEU
- Price: $49.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none (builds on 4-hour DOT Hazmat General Awareness)
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years, per 49 CFR 172 Subpart H)

## Modules
1. Hazardous Materials Regulations (definitions and classes, purpose of the HMR, enforcing agencies, training requirements)
2. Hazardous Materials Table (Columns 1 to 10, appendices, hazard class system)
3. Carrier Requirements: Rail (shipping papers, leaking or damaged packages, loading, tank car unloading, Segregation Table, switching, positioning restrictions, Association of American Railroads key train recommendations, incident reporting)
4. Security Awareness (security risk management, security plan training, Risk Management Self-Evaluation Framework)

## Who should take it
Rail carriers, rail shippers and tank car owners; staff who package, mark, label, load, unload or placard rail cars; crews and inspectors; security, emergency response and safety personnel; compliance officers.
